public_rationale: Reading ChatGPT as GPT-4.5, as the surrounding passage suggests, the reported ordering is reversed: its no-persona win rate was 36%, versus ELIZA's 23%. This does not establish a statistically significant GPT-4.5 advantage; the paper found none in either population. A GPT-4o reading would support the numerical claim, because that model scored 21%. The proposed outcome therefore depends on the explicitly stated model interpretation.
limitations: The model ambiguity materially changes the outcome.
